figurative_meaning_en: Something that has been ruined or spoiled
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার ব্যবসা সম্পূর্ণ গুণচট হয়ে গেছে।
এই ফলগুলো গুণচট, খাওয়া যাবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: His business has completely gone to ruin.
These fruits are spoiled and can't be eaten.
note: Refers to loss of value or quality, often in economic contexts
